goal: In 90 days, Foothills Quarter Horses will launch a half-day horsemanship experience for up to six guests at $145 per person. The experience will run every Saturday morning from late May through September, with the first paying departure on May 24, 2025. By the end of June, the ranch will have welcomed at least 12 paying guests and established a repeatable booking and operations workflow.

weeks.title: Week 1: Know Your Guest
actions: Write your ideal guest persona
Identify who this experience is not for
Review competitor experiences in the region for pricing and positioning
checklist: Guest persona document is complete and saved
"Not for" statement is written
Competitor review notes are captured

weeks.title: Week 2: Map the Arc
actions: Outline the beginning, middle, and end of the experience
Define what is included and what is not
Walk through the experience mentally from guest arrival to departure
checklist: Experience arc document is complete
Inclusions and exclusions list is finalised
Timing for each segment is estimated

weeks.title: Week 3: Write the Sentence
actions: Draft three versions of your one-sentence description
Test your favourite version on someone who has never visited
Finalise and save your one-sentence description
checklist: Three draft sentences are written
One sentence is tested and selected
Final sentence is saved for listing copy

weeks.title: Week 4: Calculate Costs
actions: List your fixed costs per departure
Calculate your time cost
Add a margin for unexpected costs
checklist: Fixed costs are documented with dollar amounts
Labour cost per departure is calculated
Total cost per departure (with margin) is confirmed

weeks.title: Week 5: Set Your Price
actions: Calculate your break-even point
Set your final per-guest price
Decide on a minimum booking policy
checklist: Break-even price per guest is calculated
Final price of $145 per guest is confirmed
Minimum booking policy is documented

weeks.title: Week 6: Confirm Insurance
actions: Contact your insurance broker about commercial liability
Request a certificate of insurance for booking platforms
Check permit and licence requirements with the MD of Pincher Creek
checklist: Insurance broker has confirmed coverage
Certificate of insurance is received
Business licence requirements are confirmed

weeks.title: Week 7: Safety and Policies
actions: Write your safety protocol and emergency procedures
Draft your cancellation and weather policy
Have your waiver reviewed by your insurance broker
checklist: Safety protocol document is complete
Cancellation policy is written
Guest waiver is reviewed and ready

weeks.title: Week 8: Choose Your Platform
actions: Evaluate booking platform options
Create your platform account and complete your host profile
Explore the platform dashboard and settings
checklist: Platform decision is made
Account is created and profile is complete
Dashboard navigation is understood

weeks.title: Week 9: Write Your Listing
actions: Write your listing headline
Write the full listing description
Set your availability and pricing in the platform
checklist: Headline is under 60 characters and compelling
Full description is written and reviewed
Availability and pricing are configured

weeks.title: Week 10: Shoot Your Photos
actions: Plan and shoot your listing photos
Select the 8-12 strongest photos
Edit photos for brightness and crop if needed
checklist: Photo shoot is complete
Photos are selected and edited
Photos are ready for upload

weeks.title: Week 11: Go Live
actions: Upload photos and finalise listing
Preview listing on mobile and desktop
Publish and share your listing
checklist: All photos are uploaded with alt text
Listing is previewed and looks correct
Listing is live and shareable link is confirmed

weeks.title: Week 12: First Booking
actions: Share listing with your network and local tourism contacts
Follow up with interested guests
Confirm your first booking
checklist: Listing has been shared on social media and email
At least one booking is confirmed for May 24
Guest communication is complete and departure is ready
